name: Cup Noodles Mazedaar Masala
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Dehydrated Pieces 4.26% (Corn, Green Pea, Carrot, French Beans & Curry Leaves), lodised Salt, Mixed Spices 1.55% (Red Chilli, Turmeric, Coriander, Black Pepper, Cumin, Fenugreek, Ginger, Clove, Nutmeg & Green Cardamom), Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein Powder (Soya), Onion Powder, Corn Starch, Sugar, Maltodextrin, Yeast Extract Powder Flavour Enhancers (INS 631, INS 627 & INS 620), Acidity Regulators [INS 500(1), INS 451 & INS 330], Thickener (INS 415) & Antioxidant (INS 319). ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS WHEAT & SOY. MAY CONTAIN MILK.
